items.item: Working demo
items.proof: Autopilot Console and /live walk goal, plan, new information, revised decision, result on the real sandbox (18 recorded cycles)

items.item: Video walkthrough under 5 minutes
items.proof: recorded: the 4:58 walkthrough (https://youtu.be/r6JKdr0MBeM) and the full 14-minute tour (https://youtu.be/lNEL_iDV1y8)

items.item: Repository with setup instructions
items.proof: public repository https://github.com/syehsyoh-dokling/VENTHORA, README quick start, CI green on every push

items.item: Built on Airwallex APIs
items.proof: balances, rates, quotes, conversions, beneficiaries, transfers, deposits, simulation, issuing, webhooks

items.item: Sandbox only, /api/v1 base
items.proof: the executor refuses non-sandbox URLs

items.item: Client id + API key, then a Bearer token
items.proof: token cached, refreshed 60 s before expiry, retried once on 401

items.item: One request_id per operation, reused only on retry
items.proof: request_id persisted before every call; a lost response is recovered, never resent

items.item: Credentials never in code or prompts
items.proof: write-only secret store; scoped API keys; the model never sees a credential

items.item: Back off on 429, no parallel bursts
items.proof: retries with backoff on 429/5xx; execution is sequential

items.item: A finance decision that changes with balance, deadline, evidence or risk
items.proof: pay, convert, defer or escalate; a delay email or a deposit revises the plan

items.item: Say which actions need a person
items.proof: Delegation of Authority and the approval matrix (four-eyes)

items.item: Rules and limits in code, not in the prompt
items.proof: ProofCore + Rego mirror: 0 disagreements on 10,618 inputs

items.item: The model reads, compares evidence, proposes and explains
items.proof: Claude reads invoices and claims (model+rules), proposes the plan, explains exceptions

items.item: Approval bound to amount, currency, counterparty and terms
items.proof: terms_digest on every approval; execution refuses an approval on other terms

items.item: End in a financial action or an escalation
items.proof: conversions and transfers executed; exceptions escalated

items.item: Fund the critical bill, convert the minimum, defer the cheapest, escalate the exception
items.proof: SHIPPING paid, minimum conversion, SaaS deferred, changed bank details escalated

items.item: Recalculate only what a deposit affects
items.proof: incremental re-plan with locked decisions and a diff

items.item: Execution limit tied to forecast confidence
items.proof: 90% -> 70% lowers the limit; the same conversion then needs a person

items.item: Execute one conversion and one transfer, confirm the reserve
items.proof: real sandbox cycle 4; reserve confirmed at reconciliation

items.item: SWIFT fee added to the conversion
items.proof: observed fees override the guide's EUR 12.85; FX & transfer costs report, with Visa's daily rate beside it

items.item: Beneficiary schema before every create
items.proof: required fields compared; a missing one fails before create

items.item: Poll to a terminal state; read failure_type
items.proof: only PAID/CANCELLED/FAILED are terminal

items.item: Global Account, deposits, re-read balances
items.proof: deposit counted only when /deposits says SETTLED; webhook through venthora.muwahid.org in 4 s

items.item: Wait, replace or escalate a failed transfer under the duplicate lock
items.proof: all 32 Airwallex failure types; real sandbox cycle 5

groups.title: Kit 02 cards and the Visa award

items.item: Issue virtual cards with limits inside the mandate
items.proof: live on the staging server since 13 Nov: cardholders and virtual cards issued with limits inside the mandate for each company's connected account; staff advances paid on a card and spent

items.item: Remote authorization: VENTHORA answers every charge
items.proof: live since 13 Nov: Airwallex calls the platform's remote-authorization URL, the platform checks the signature and the company that issued the card answers (wrong merchant declined, right merchant approved)

items.item: Freeze a card (agent revokes its own authority)
items.proof: POST issuing/cards/{id}/update card_status INACTIVE; still frozen in VENTHORA if Airwallex is unreachable

items.item: Read card limits and remaining
items.proof: GET issuing/cards/{id}/limits compared with the mandate; drift goes to the audit chain

items.item: Card spend report
items.proof: every decision joined with Airwallex's authorization and clearing

items.item: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol (agent signatures)
items.proof: public keys at /.well-known/venthora-agent.json

items.item: Visa Supplier Matching: does a vendor take Visa cards?
items.proof: every vendor checked with Visa (X-Pay, sandbox): a confident match pays by Visa virtual card locked to Visa's MCC, otherwise bank transfer; also on Procurement → Quotation

items.item: Visa Intelligent Commerce
items.proof: X-Pay signing works on the live server (helloworld 200), Visa FX rates and Supplier Matching answer from the sandbox; the VIC consumer and card token wait for Visa's onboarding

items.item: Claude as the model
items.proof: Claude Opus 5.5 reads, plans, explains, searches vendors and checks quotations

items.item: Alta: anchor the audit head and every contract head on testnet
items.proof: Alta Testnet (chain 63825): VENTHORA bought its own RPC endpoint over x402 (1 USDZ, EIP-3009), funded gas from the faucet API and anchored 10 contracts + 212 audit events in one transaction (status 1, 23,000 gas, final in about a second)

items.item: AWS Bedrock as a model provider
items.proof: Bedrock Converse provider built and selectable; the key tried lists models, but the account refuses model calls

items.item: Airwallex MCP servers
items.proof: docs server connected; the developer server needs OAuth (REST is allowed by the guide)

items.item: Kit 09 shopping agent (Airi CLI)
items.proof: the Airi CLI is installed on the live server (16 Nov); signing in is the company's own Airi account. The procurement agent binds approval to vendor, items and total

items.item: Kits 05 and 06 connected accounts
items.proof: connected accounts enabled on 13 Nov: every company on the platform opens its own Airwallex connected account under VENTHORA's platform account; funds never mix

items.item: Procurement: 3 quotations, recommendation, human award, PO
items.proof: brand and specification lock, model reads remarks, award outside the recommendation only with a reason
